name: Ötztal Bike Days
beschreibung: The Ötztal Bike Days are the biggest mountain biking event of the year. The program includes guided tours, bike tests of the latest models, a skillfulness course, pump-track races, and a bike expo. Every level finds the perfect challenge.
kurzbeschreibung: The massive mountain biking event featuring guided tours, bike tests, and races in the **Ötztal**.
